messages:
Maya Chopra: Quick data dump — ran slices comparing nimbus-13b-int6 vs zephyr-13b-int8 on our longer-doc QA slice (seq=1024). Results below.

```
model,nps,latency_p95(ms),QA_F1,unit_cost_per_1k_tokens
nimbus-13b-int6,120,95,78.1,$0.80
zephyr-13b-int8,80,70,80.5,$1.22
baseline-13b-fp16,60,65,81.0,$2.10
```

Initial take: int6 gives ~2.4 F1 drop vs int8 but ~34% cheaper per token.

Luke Chen: Hmm. 2.4% F1 on long-form is noticeable for GTN help search. What's the breakdown by prompt length?

Maya Chopra: At seq<256 gap is only 0.8 F1; gap blows up with longer context. Also KV cache priming cost adds ~30ms average on int6 for warm-start.

Sophia Ramos: Could we try hybrid routing: route short prompts to nimbus-int6, long ones to zephyr-int8? Also consider a 10% high-fidelity shadow to surface regressions.

Luke Chen: Agreed. Routing thresholds: seq_len <= 256 -> int6; 256-1024 -> int8; >1024 -> fp16 baseline. Also add fallback to fp16 on low-confidence responses.

Maya Chopra: Proposed route config (simple):

```
routing:
  - condition: prompt_len <= 256
    model: nimbus-13b-int6
  - condition: 256 < prompt_len <= 1024
    model: zephyr-13b-int8
  - condition: prompt_len > 1024
    model: baseline-13b-fp16
  fallback: baseline-13b-fp16
  shadow_traffic: 10% -> baseline-13b-fp16
```

GTN Product: @Maya can you write up the recommendation for the product handoff? Need a short blurb for the playbook.

Maya Chopra: Yep — will prepare a scorecard with slices and acceptance criteria: QA_F1 drop <=1% (short), <=1.5% (mid), <=2.5% (long) for promotion. Canary plan: 5% ingress for 48h, monitor F1, latency_p95, user_rtt, and rollback if F1 drift >1.5 on any critical slice.

Luke Chen: Also add token-econ: expected unit cost reduction ~30% for general traffic, downside 2% quality hit on long-form queries. Flag for GTN: tradeoff between query throughput and answer quality on troubleshooting flows.

Sophia Ramos: Note on ops: KV cache warmup artifact — ensure kvcache metrics in tracing (kvcache_miss_rate, kvcache_warm_latency). I'll add dashboard widgets.

Maya Chopra: Link to draft doc: https://docs.google.com/draft/gtn-routing-nimbus-zephyr (will actually upload scorecard later). :memo:

deploy-bot: Canary created: canary-1829 (5% traffic -> zephyr-int8 for mid-range, nimbus-int6 for short) — started 1767007805 :rocket:

Luke Chen: thanks — monitoring now. if we see F1 drop >1.5 anywhere we'll rollback automatically.

Sophia Ramos: small follow-up: can we run a quick quant-sensitivity test with different temp settings? might mitigate hallucination on int6.

Maya Chopra: good idea — I'll run those overnight and post summary in morning.

GTN Product: great, thanks team. :thumbsup:
